turn.content: The records settle this one. The contract sets PPN at 11% of subtotal, but the invoice applied 12% (9,979,800 × 12% = 1,197,576 exactly). Note also that `get_billing_position` on PO-2026-0259 confirms the goods were fully received (GR-2026-0259 covers every line) and the received value with tax at the correct rate would be 11,077,578 — the invoice total exceeds that only because of the inflated tax, so quantity/price per line are fine and the sole discrepancy is the rate.
